mapper.select: SELECT id, project_name, province, city, operator, industry, tenderer, win_tenderer, ROUND(COALESCE(win_bid_price, 0) / 10000, 2) AS win_bid_price_wan, DATE_FORMAT(publish_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS publish_time, join_status, lost_reason, AS review_status, AS situation_desc FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid WHERE ORDER BY win_bid_price DESC, publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS lost_count, COALESCE(SUM(win_bid_price), 0) AS lost_amount_yuan, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(win_bid_price), 0) / 10000, 2) AS lost_amount_wan, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(win_bid_price) / 10000, 2), 0) AS avg_amount_wan, SUM(CASE WHEN lost_reason IS NULL OR TRIM(lost_reason) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reason_missing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN IS NULL OR TRIM() = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS situation_missing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN IS NULL OR TRIM() = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS review_missing_count, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(publish_time), '%Y-%m-%d') AS earliest_publish_time, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(publish_time), '%Y-%m-%d') AS latest_publish_time FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid WHERE

SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(lost_reason), ''), '未填写原因') AS lost_reason, COUNT(*) AS lost_count, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(win_bid_price), 0) / 10000, 2) AS lost_amount_wan, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(publish_time), '%Y-%m-%d') AS latest_publish_time FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid WHERE GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(lost_reason), ''), '未填写原因') ORDER BY lost_count DESC, lost_amount_wan DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(industry), ''), '未填写行业') AS industry, COUNT(*) AS lost_count, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(win_bid_price), 0) / 10000, 2) AS lost_amount_wan, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(publish_time), '%Y-%m-%d') AS latest_publish_time FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid WHERE GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(industry), ''), '未填写行业') ORDER BY lost_count DESC, lost_amount_wan DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(), ''), '未填写') AS review_status, COUNT(*) AS lost_count, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(win_bid_price), 0) / 10000, 2) AS lost_amount_wan FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid WHERE GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(), ''), '未填写') ORDER BY lost_count DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(operator), ''), '未填写') AS operator, COUNT(*) AS lost_count, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(win_bid_price), 0) / 10000, 2) AS lost_amount_wan FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid WHERE GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(operator), ''), '未填写') ORDER BY lost_count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(join_status), ''), '未填写') AS join_status, COUNT(*) AS lost_count, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(win_bid_price), 0) / 10000, 2) AS lost_amount_wan FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid WHERE GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(join_status), ''), '未填写') ORDER BY lost_count DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(city), ''), '未填写地市') AS city, COUNT(*) AS lost_count, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(win_bid_price), 0) / 10000, 2) AS lost_amount_wan FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid WHERE GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(city), ''), '未填写地市') ORDER BY lost_count DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(publish_time, '%x-W%v') AS week, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(publish_time), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week_start, COUNT(*) AS lost_count, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(win_bid_price), 0) / 10000, 2) AS lost_amount_wan FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid WHERE GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(publish_time, '%x-W%v') ORDER BY week LIMIT 30

SELECT CASE WHEN win_tenderer LIKE '%移动%' OR win_tenderer LIKE '%中移%' OR win_tenderer LIKE '%铁通%' THEN '移动系' WHEN win_tenderer LIKE '%电信%' OR win_tenderer LIKE '%天翼%' THEN '电信系' WHEN win_tenderer LIKE '%联通%' OR win_tenderer LIKE '%网通%' OR win_tenderer LIKE '%数科%' OR win_tenderer LIKE '%产互%' THEN '联通系' WHEN win_tenderer LIKE '%广电%' OR win_tenderer LIKE '%吉视%' OR win_tenderer LIKE '%铁塔%' THEN '广电/铁塔' ELSE '本地集成商/专业厂商/其他' END AS winner_family, COUNT(*) AS lost_count, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(win_bid_price), 0) / 10000, 2) AS lost_amount_wan FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid WHERE GROUP BY CASE WHEN win_tenderer LIKE '%移动%' OR win_tenderer LIKE '%中移%' OR win_tenderer LIKE '%铁通%' THEN '移动系' WHEN win_tenderer LIKE '%电信%' OR win_tenderer LIKE '%天翼%' THEN '电信系' WHEN win_tenderer LIKE '%联通%' OR win_tenderer LIKE '%网通%' OR win_tenderer LIKE '%数科%' OR win_tenderer LIKE '%产互%' THEN '联通系' WHEN win_tenderer LIKE '%广电%' OR win_tenderer LIKE '%吉视%' OR win_tenderer LIKE '%铁塔%' THEN '广电/铁塔' ELSE '本地集成商/专业厂商/其他' END ORDER BY lost_amount_wan DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT '厂商授权/原厂配合缺失' AS mechanism, COUNT(*) AS lost_count, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(win_bid_price), 0) / 10000, 2) AS lost_amount_wan FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid WHERE AND ( LIKE '%授权%' OR LIKE '%原厂%') UNION ALL SELECT '客户指定供应商/单一来源', COUNT(*), ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(win_bid_price), 0) / 10000, 2) FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid WHERE AND ( LIKE '%单一来源%' OR LIKE '%原供应商%' OR LIKE '%原承建%' OR LIKE '%原服务商%' OR LIKE '%直接选定%' OR LIKE '%指定%') UNION ALL SELECT '不允许分包/转包', COUNT(*), ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(win_bid_price), 0) / 10000, 2) FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid WHERE AND ( LIKE '%分包%' OR LIKE '%转包%') UNION ALL SELECT '纯硬件无法计收', COUNT(*), ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(win_bid_price), 0) / 10000, 2) FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid WHERE AND ( LIKE '%无法计收%' OR LIKE '%不能计收%' OR LIKE '%纯硬件%') UNION ALL SELECT '面向中小企业采购', COUNT(*), ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(win_bid_price), 0) / 10000, 2) FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid WHERE AND LIKE '%中小企业%' UNION ALL SELECT '业绩/案例不满足', COUNT(*), ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(win_bid_price), 0) / 10000, 2) FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid WHERE AND ( LIKE '%业绩%' OR LIKE '%案例%') UNION ALL SELECT '资质不满足', COUNT(*), ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(win_bid_price), 0) / 10000, 2) FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid WHERE AND LIKE '%资质%' UNION ALL SELECT '联合体受限', COUNT(*), ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(win_bid_price), 0) / 10000, 2) FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid WHERE AND LIKE '%联合体%' UNION ALL SELECT '垫资/回款风险', COUNT(*), ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(win_bid_price), 0) / 10000, 2) FROM chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid WHERE AND ( LIKE '%垫资%' OR LIKE '%回款%') ORDER BY lost_count DESC
